CustomField.description: The featured epic's Work_Item__c Id, 18 characters. Blank means no epic is featured. Text rather than a lookup, which a custom setting cannot hold, so a deleted, retyped or unpublished epic leaves its Id here; FeaturedEpicService reads such an Id as none. Never write it by hand: use the board's button or the scripts, which check it is a public epic.
CustomField.label: Epic Id
